summary: Frontend-only verification of the new bento-grid Dashboard relayout for Goorin B2B Staff Portal. Logged in via mock auth (empty fields), landed on /#dashboard. Verified all required rv-* testids, bento layout (mint hero + Annual goal ring card with big % + 3 KPI cards + Revenue by Month + Segments/Top accounts + Account detail table). Tested at 1920x1080 and 1280x900. All acceptance criteria pass. Previous iteration_22 bug (missing '67' in gauge) is FIXED — 67% now renders clearly next to the ring.
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts occasionally logs 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings during initial layout at 1920 width (harmless — chart re-measures and paints correctly); can be silenced by ensuring the ResponsiveContainer parent has explicit minHeight/minWidth before mount.
test_credentials: Mock auth: click 'Log in' with empty fields (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).

verification_details.login: Empty-field login → routes to #dashboard; dashboard-page renders.
verification_details.hero_mint_card: rv-hero present. rv-invoiced-ytd=$11,572,416; rv-invoiced-delta='14.7% vs LY'. Area chart shows ALL 9 x-axis labels Jan,Feb,Mar,Apr,May,Jun,Jul,Aug,Sep. Segment pills rv-seg-all/us/dist switch figure: All=$11,572,416, US=$6,412,880, Dist=$5,159,536.
verification_details.goal_ring_card: rv-goal-card contains target icon + ring gauge + big 67% (rv-goal-pct='67%') with '8 pts behind' pace badge and '$11.6M of $17.3M · Pace 75%'. Numeric '67' renders correctly (previous SVG-text bug from iteration_22 is fixed).
verification_details.kpi_tiles: rv-tile-open=$9.2M (6.2% booked, not invoiced), rv-tile-total=$20.7M (3.1% invoiced+open), rv-tile-forecast=$17.3M (1.8% full-year projection). Each has icon chip.
verification_details.revenue_by_month_card: rv-chart-card renders Recharts composed chart (bars=Invoiced/Open, line=Total, dashed=Forecast). rv-range-ytd/12m/q all toggle. rv-export-btn downloads 'goorin-revenue-by-month.csv'. Tooltip shows on hover (verified at 1280: 'AUG Invoiced $1.3M / Open $0 / Total $1.3M / Forecast $1.5M').
verification_details.height_parity: rv-chart-card height=637px, rv-segments-card height=637px, diff=0px (within ±2px requirement).
verification_details.segments_top_accounts: rv-segment-us=72% of goal / 55% share / $6.4M of $8.9M. rv-segment-dist=61% / 45% / $5.1M of $8.4M. rv-top-account-1..5 = Lids ($2.7M ▼20.1%), SASAtrend ($1.4M ▼10.4%), Industrias Mercury ($1.0M ▲62.6%), Nordstrom AP ($726.5K ▼19.6%), Buckle Inc ($616.6K ▼54.8%).
verification_details.account_detail: rv-account-search filters. Typing 'lids' → rv-account-row-lids visible; expanding shows rv-account-expand-lids with 5 metrics (OPEN PIPELINE $1,744,320, CONSERVATIVE LAND $4,460,373, FULL-YEAR FORECAST $4,460,373 +$1.5M vs goal, ANNUAL GOAL $3,000,000, PRIOR YEAR $4,683,724 -20.1% YoY) + rv-open-account-lids button. Gibberish 'zzqqxx' → rv-account-empty visible. 220 accounts total.
verification_details.responsive: 1920x1080 and 1280x900 both render without horizontal overflow, clipping, or overlap. Bento reflows correctly.
verification_details.console: No console errors captured during full flow at both viewports (only Recharts layout warnings on initial mount, non-blocking).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard bento relayout is fully functional and visually clean. All rv-* testids present. Iteration_22 gauge bug is resolved. No open issues.
